title: Pricing & Packages
questions: How much does physical therapy cost?

Initial Evaluation — $225. Follow-Up Visit — $175. Prepaid care packages are also available: Recover — $700, Build — $1,000, and Perform — $1,300. Package details and savings are available on our Pricing page.
Do I have to purchase a package?
No. Packages are completely optional. You can pay for visits individually and decide how you’d like to proceed after your evaluation.
How do I know how many visits I’ll need?

That depends on your injury, goals, and how you respond to treatment. We’ll discuss your expected plan of care after your evaluation rather than automatically scheduling you for a predetermined number of visits.
